use_case_name: Initiate and Clear Surveillance Track Alerts

claims.content: To initiate and clear operator alerts associated with surveillance track data.

goal.raw_text: To initiate and clear operator alerts associated with surveillance track data.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU has a surveillance database.
The C2 JU has the capability to initiate/terminate a force tell alert on another JU by setting/clearing the FT IND in a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message.

When a JU with R² initiates an emergency or force tell alert on tracks by setting the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND in a J3.2, J3.3, J3.4, or J3.5 message, or terminates an emergency or force tell alert by transmitting a J7.0 (ACT = 3 or 4) message, the use case is initiated.

trigger.raw_text: When a JU with R² initiates an emergency or force tell alert on tracks by setting the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND in a J3.2, J3.3, J3.4, or J3.5 message, or terminates an emergency or force tell alert by transmitting a J7.0 (ACT = 3 or 4) message, the use case is initiated.

claims.content: C2 JU initiates an emergency alert on itself by setting the EMG IND in its J2 messages.
All receiving C2 JUs accept the alert in their databases.
C2 JU initiates a force tell alert on another JU by setting the FT IND in a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message.
Upon receipt, the JU whose force tell status is being changed accepts and reports the change in its J2 message.
Other JUs set the alert indicator in their databases upon receipt of the J7.0 (ACT = 4) message.
C2 JU terminates a force tell alert on another JU by clearing the FT IND in a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message.
Other JUs clear the alert indicator in their databases upon receipt of the J7.0 (ACT = 4) message.
C2 JU clears the operator alert (any mode).
At main flow step 7, alternative path 1: C2 JU initiates J7.5 (ACT = 0) Clear IFF/SIF message (any mode).
At main flow step 7, alternative path 2: C2 JU initiates J7.5 (ACT = 1) IFF/SIF Difference Report message (any mode).
At main flow step 7, alternative path 3: C2 JU changes local data to agree with remote data except in the case of Mode II code.
At main flow step 7, alternative path 4: C2 JU decorrelates the local data from the remote data, causing the assignment of a new track number to local data.

At main flow step 7, alternative path 5: C2 JU initiates J7.5 (ACT = 1) IFF/SIF Difference Report message when locally entered data changes from zero to nonzero or nonzero to another nonzero value, or in response to a J3.XC1 “NO DATA” report on one or more mode/code when local nonzero IFF/SIF is held; the message may be initiated by operator action anytime.
If a JU would initiate or terminate an emergency alert on another Active JU, it shall not initiate or terminate that emergency alert; exit the use case.
When the C2 JU initiates an emergency alert on itself, the EMG IND is set in its J2 messages, and all receiving C2 JUs have accepted the alert in their databases.

When a force tell alert is initiated or terminated on another JU, the FT IND in a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message has been set or cleared, and the JU whose force tell status is being changed has accepted and reported the change in its J2 message.
Other JUs have set or cleared the alert indicator in their databases upon receipt of the J7.0 (ACT = 4) message.
When an emergency alert is terminated, an EMG IND set to 1 has been reset to 0 through use of a J7.0 (ACT = 3) Emergency Status Change message.
When a force tell alert is terminated, an FT IND set to 1 has been reset to 0 through use of a J7.0 (ACT = 4) Force Tell Status Change message.
The operator alert (any mode) is cleared.
